mechanism: Perphenazine may increase risk of hypotension and CNS depression when combined with zoledronic acid, which can cause acute phase reactions and electrolyte disturbances; both agents have potential to affect renal function and cause orthostatic hypotension.
action: Monitor blood pressure, renal function, and electrolytes closely; ensure adequate hydration during zoledronic acid infusion; assess for additive CNS and hypotensive effects.
